content: LCP under 2.5s correlates with ~5.1% median conversion vs 3.4% for LCP over 4s (up to 61% conversion lift from good LCP per a Rakuten case study). GIFs don't block page load the way heavy video does; static screenshots are safest for CWV. Video/GIF increases engagement/comprehension but must never autoplay with sound and should sit near top without replacing headline/CTA.
